saw_lines: Tool buyers arrive knowing the brand and model, then look for proof other pros trust it before they buy.
So the sale is won or lost on the product page, where a proof number must answer that before the cart.
Your 9 live Meta ads carry no proof number, so collect one review count or orders shipped and lead with it in your next batch.
ads_1: Paid creative: a review count and a shipping promise on every tool ad
soc_1: Brand social strategy for the channels your buyers already use
